data.name: Misbaq
data.gender_notes: Misbaq is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Miswak' which means a stick used for cleaning the teeth or a lantern. In Islamic culture, it symbolizes illuminating the path to guidance and righteousness. The name Misbaq carries the meaning “Lantern” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Misbaq usually hope their child will grow to embody lantern and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Guides and illuminates the path to righteousness
data.etymology: Misbaq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lantern.”

in_arabic.name: مصبق
in_arabic.meaning: مصبق يعني الشخص الذي يضيء ويشرق بوجوده
in_arabic.long_meaning: مصبق هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ص-ب-ق' والذي يعني 'الضياء' أو 'النور'. يرمز الاسم إلى الشخص الذي يضيء ويشرق بوجوده، ويكون له تأثير إيجابي على من حوله. كما يمكن أن يشير إلى الشخص الذي يتمتع بشخصية مشرقة ومتألقة.

in_urdu.name: مصبق
in_urdu.meaning: مصبق کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو اپنے وجود سے روشنی اور چمک پیدا کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: مصبق ایک عربی نام ہے جو 'ص-ب-ق' کے جذر سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے 'روشنی' یا 'چمک'. یہ نام اس شخص کو مخاطب کرتا ہے جو اپنے وجود سے دوسروں کو روشنی اور امید دیتا ہے. اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام ان شخصیات کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو اپنے مجتمع پر مثبت اثر ڈالتے ہیں.

in_hindi.name: मिस्बक
in_hindi.meaning: मिस्बक का अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो अपने अस्तित्व से प्रकाश और चमक लाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मिस्बक एक अरबी नाम है जो 'ص-ب-ق' मूल से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है 'प्रकाश' या 'चमक'. यह नाम उस व्यक्ति को संबोधित करता है जो अपने अस्तित्व से दूसरों को प्रकाश और आशा देता है. भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो अपने समाज पर सकारात्मक प्रभाव डालते हैं.

in_pashto.name: مصبق
in_pashto.meaning: مصبق د هغه چا معنی دی چی د خپل وجود څخه رڼا او چمک ورکوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: مصبق د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی، چي د 'ص-ب-ق' په ريښې جوړ شوی دی، او د 'رڼا' يا 'چمک' معنی ورکوي. دا نوم هغه چا ته اشاره کوي چي د خپل وجود څخه د نورو لپاره رڼا او امید رامینځته کوي. په پښتنو او افغانانو کې، دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کېږي چي د خپل ټولنې پرمثبت اغېز لرونکي دي.

in_english.name: Misbaq
in_english.meaning: Misbaq means one who brings light and radiance
in_english.long_meaning: The name Misbaq originates from the Arabic root 'ص-ب-ق' (s-b-q), which means 'light,' 'radiance,' or 'illumination.' In Islamic tradition, Misbaq signifies a person who brings light, hope, and positivity to others. The name reflects a person with a bright personality, intellect, and character. Historically, names derived from this root have been used to denote individuals who have had a significant, enlightening impact on their communities.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Misbaq" holds a strong cultural significance for Muslims, as it takes inspiration from a commonly used item called 'Miswak'. Miswak is a small stick, usually made from the 'Arak' tree, used for cleaning the teeth. It is considered an essential part of personal hygiene in Islam, traiding back to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) who is reported to have used it. The name Misbaq therefore carries a connection to the practice of cleanliness, a recognized pillar of faith in Islam.
data.spiritual_significance: "Misbaq" also holds profound spiritual significance for Muslims. The name represents the concept of Illuminating the Path to Guidance, echoing the Islamic belief in seeking knowledge and moral values to light up our lives. In the simplest terms, this name signifies the pursuit of righteousness and striving towards a close relationship with Allah SWT. Just as a lantern illuminates the path for us in the dark, this name serves as a reminder of our ultimate goal in life - to seek eternal happiness in the presence of Allah SWT.
